newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end down, seen falling.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end down, seen falling.

text.p: Pakistani stocks dropped at close on Sunday amid weak floor sentiment prompted by the killing of Prime Minister Benazir Bhutto's estranged brother Murtaza Bhutto in Friday's shootout with police, dealers said.
They said the market was likely to open lower on Monday owing to political uncertainty.

The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index fell 25.07 points, or 1.74 percent, to end at 1,413.74. Losers led gainers 160 to 74. Turnover fell to 21 million shares from 49 million on the previous trading day on Thursday.

Askari Bank fell 1.95 rupees to 21.30 and Faysal Bank 1.45 to 22.25. Dewan Salman Fibre fell 1.0 to 22.50, Hub Power Co 0.80 to 33.40 and Karachi Electric Supply 1.40 to 22. PTCL fell 1.10 to 34.40. Fauji Fertilizer fell 1.0 to 68.50.
